name: engram
description: Persistent shared memory for Codex. Configure ENGRAM_URL; use a dashboard-issued ENGRAM_TOKEN worker keycard only when the server requires authentication. The server operator key must stay on the server host.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent shared memory for Codex workspaces
interface.longDescription: Engram connects Codex to a shared PostgreSQL-backed memory service. Configure ENGRAM_URL and, for auth-enabled servers, ENGRAM_TOKEN with a worker keycard issued from the Engram dashboard /access page; never use the server operator key on a workstation.
defaultPrompt: Configure Engram for Codex with the server URL and, when server authentication is enabled, a dashboard-issued worker keycard. Use the supported Engram config file. Run node <this installed plugin directory>/scripts/run-engram.js codex-config and place its output in Codex config.toml: the absolute launcher inherits the thread working directory.
Run Engram Doctor to verify the MCP connection and report the server version.
